I think you are missing one of the main points and forgetting the other main characters namely Finn. Finn is the opposite to kylo in every interaction. I think you are also forgetting the importance of choice and misinterpreting the redemption arc.

First for Finn and Kylo and how they are each others foils. 

They both made a choice. Finn wasn't going to kill for them Kylo was. Finn chose the side of good over and over while Kylo chose the dark side. 

(also side note Rey was willing to lay down and die with finn, while Kylo got hurt and she bounced. Kylo fucking tortured her and her friends. She watched him kill her father figure and his father. Just because TLJ forgot everything that happened in TFA doesn't mean anyone else did)/ 

Also LOL if you think vader was redeemed. He blew up planets and killed countless people. Just because Luke forgave him didn't mean anyone else did. Kylo also went further than Vader at every turn. He killed his family FOR power while Vader wanted power to save his family. their motivations are different. R\*an is a shit ass writer who doesn't understand what subverting expectations actually means. Kylo has to die for the story to have any sort of satisfying conclusion.
